volumes.L: bare forearm, hand and fingers (1029 vertices)
volumes.R: bare forearm, hand and fingers (1029 vertices)

idle.purpose: relaxed breathing stance, the launcher low in the right hand, the left hand loose, weight drifting
idle.maps_to: alive, not moving, out of combat (no enemy near, no attack for 2 s; hub)

idle_combat.purpose: the combat hold: bladed, the launcher at the right hip on the aim, the left hand on the foregrip, a light bounce on the knees
idle_combat.maps_to: alive, not moving, in combat (enemies near or an attack in the last 2 s). Frame 0 is the reference pose of every upper-layer clip

walk.purpose: a light, upright walk, hips swaying, the launcher carried low, the left arm swinging
walk.maps_to: moving at under about 55 % of move speed (stick partly pushed, slows); playback rate = speed / 1.72 m/s

run.purpose: a long, light run leaning into the move, the launcher held at the hip on the aim with both hands
run.maps_to: moving within 45 deg of the aim at move speed; playback rate = speed / 7.0 m/s

strafe_left.purpose: side run to her left, hips opened toward the travel, the chest and the launcher kept on the aim
strafe_left.maps_to: moving 45-135 deg to the left of the aim; playback rate = speed / 7.0 m/s

strafe_right.purpose: side run to her right, the hips turned into the travel, the launcher kept on the aim
strafe_right.maps_to: moving 45-135 deg to the right of the aim; playback rate = speed / 7.0 m/s

backpedal.purpose: backpedal on the balls of her feet, the launcher up on the aim
backpedal.maps_to: moving more than 135 deg away from the aim; playback rate = speed / 7.0 m/s

dash.purpose: the dash burst: a low lunge-glide leaning into the move, the launcher tucked on the aim in the right hand (the left lets go of the foregrip for the lunge), the capes streaming
dash.maps_to: the 0.16 s dash (MoverState.dash_left > 0); the client faces the hero along the dash for its duration

dash_recover.purpose: landing out of the dash: the lead foot plants, a soft absorb, back into the hold
dash_recover.maps_to: the first 0.45 s after a dash ends when the hero is not moving on (else blend into locomotion)

fire_light.purpose: one orb shot: a snap forward, the launcher kicks up and back, the body rides it (recoil stays procedural)
fire_light.maps_to: each primary shot of a light chassis (fire_rate >= 2/s: the thundercoil_launcher fires 3.5/s)

fire_heavy.purpose: a charged shot: brace into the aim, release, the launcher bucks up and the body rocks back
fire_heavy.maps_to: a heavy / charged release (fire_rate < 1/s, charge release, splash chassis)

fire_charge.purpose: holding a charge: braced low behind the launcher, trembling with the stored storm
fire_charge.maps_to: fire held on a Charge chassis (FireKind::Charge) until release (then fire_heavy)

hit_light.purpose: a flinch: the head snaps, the launcher is knocked up, absorb, recover
hit_light.maps_to: PlayerFlags::HIT on a light hit (damage < 10 % max HP), layered over whatever plays

hit_heavy.purpose: a big stagger: blown back, the left hand torn off the foregrip, the lead foot steps back, absorb, step back in
hit_heavy.maps_to: PlayerFlags::HIT on a heavy hit (damage >= 10 % max HP or a stun); interrupts upper-layer clips

knockdown.purpose: blown off her feet: impact, a backward fall, the bounce, lying on her back with the capes spread
knockdown.maps_to: a knockback / launch strong enough to floor the hero (stun >= 0.8 s); holds its last frame until get_up

get_up.purpose: from her back: up on the left hand, roll onto one knee with the launcher gathered in, rise into the hold

death.purpose: the fatal blow: the head snaps back, the launcher sags, the knees buckle, she topples face down
death.maps_to: LifeState::Downed begins (GameEvent::Downed); holds its last frame, then downed@loop (wraith look)

downed.purpose: the wraith drift: slumped, floating 0.35 m off the ground, the launcher trailing from a limp hand, a slow bob
downed.maps_to: LifeState::Downed (the Soul-Tether wraith; moves at 45 % speed with no gait, the client adds the ghost material)

revive.purpose: pulled back into the body: a jolt with the arms flung wide, the feet slam down, crouch, rise into the hold
revive.maps_to: an ally completes the Soul-Tether revive (Downed -> Alive)

reforge_in.purpose: forged anew: rises from a one-knee landing (the left claws on the ground), snaps the launcher up, takes the hold
reforge_in.maps_to: LifeState::Reforging ends: the hero reappears next to an ally

victory.purpose: the storm answers: a crouch, then the launcher thrust to the sky, the left hand open wide; holds the pose
victory.maps_to: the run is won (GameEvent victory / boss down, results screen); holds its last frame

ping.purpose: a ping: the left hand leaves the foregrip and points along the aim, open, the head follows

interact.purpose: work the anvil: lean over and press the left claws onto it (the launcher kept low in the right hand), straighten
interact.maps_to: the interact input at an anvil / forge / shrine POI (PoiState use); 1.3 s

forge_hammer.purpose: charging the anvil: the left palm raised, slammed down onto the work in a crackle, again
forge_hammer.maps_to: the forge / hub anvil upgrade (Forge screen open, hub idle at the anvil)

idle_signature.purpose: lightning in human shape, barely touching the ground: a slow hover sway a hand's breadth up, the left claws flexing (the crackle; the vein pulse is an emissive VFX), the cloth breathing, the crown bobbing
idle_signature.maps_to: standing out of combat for 6 s (then back to idle on any input)

arc_nova.purpose: Arc Nova: gather (the left claws clenched at the chest), then both hands snap forward and apart, the claws spread, the launcher thrust out: the chain burst leaves her
arc_nova.maps_to: active1 Arc Nova cast (chain-lightning burst); upper layer, so she keeps moving

blink_out.purpose: Blink, out: a crouch and a lean into the move; the model is hidden from the 'vanish' frame (storm trail VFX)
blink_out.maps_to: active2 Blink starts (the 7 m teleport through enemies); the client hides the model at 'vanish'

blink_in.purpose: Blink, in: she arrives leaning out of the jump, lands soft on the lead foot and settles into the hold
blink_in.maps_to: active2 Blink ends (the model reappears at the target point)

heavens_verdict_start.purpose: Heaven's Verdict, the call: gather low, sweep both arms up, head back, lifted off the ground as the storm front is called ('call'); ends on the verdict loop's frame 0
heavens_verdict_start.maps_to: ultimate Heaven's Verdict cast (the storm front placed at the aim point)

heavens_verdict.purpose: Heaven's Verdict, sustained: hovering with both arms raised to the storm, a slow sway, the crown swaying wide round the head (the shard bones), the cloth lifted
heavens_verdict.maps_to: while the Heaven's Verdict cast lasts (the client may cut back to locomotion when she moves)

static_charge.purpose: Static Charge full: the left hand leaves the foregrip and clenches in front of her chest, trembling, a crackle; back to the foregrip
static_charge.maps_to: passive Static Charge reaches its cap (+60 %): played once in the upper layer
